invariant: A named floating note is a real NOTE leaf stored on the same Plasma quark used by every other class-diagram entity. CommandFactoryNote resolves the alias with quarkInContext(false), so an unqualified alias is created under the current package even when another package contains a same-named leaf. reallyCreateLeaf stores the NOTE Entity on that quark. CommandLinkClass later resolves both endpoints with quarkInContextSafe(true); a unique unqualified alias therefore returns the existing note quark and its non-null data prevents construction of a phantom CLASS. The Link retains the note Entity itself. GraphvizImageBuilder can consequently count the note's links, consume a singly linked note edge as Opale, preserve the package-qualified SVG identity from Quark.getQualifiedName, and use the local Quark.getName for link comments and path IDs.
causal_divergence: Rust originally stored floating aliases only in Note.alias and emitted a UID event. It did not register the note's canonical quark path or make that path resolvable as relationship endpoint data, so a later relationship constructed a phantom CLASS. Commits eaba4b71 and 842f8604 corrected that shared-quark model by storing Note.id and resolving relationships through it. The independent review then found one remaining renderer defect: note_qualified_name still discards Note.id and reconstructs a package-owned note as package_qualified_name(owner) + '.' + translated alias. Under `set namespaceSeparator ::`, Java EntityImageNote serializes Quark.getQualifiedName (`Archive9761::Memo9765`) and the SVG writer translates each colon independently, producing `Archive9761..Memo9765`; Rust reconstruction loses the separator punctuation and produces `Archive9761.Memo9765`. This is a canonical-identity projection defect, not a layout or comparator issue.
planned_change: Keep the shared-quark parser and relationship resolution from 842f8604. Change note_qualified_name to prefer the canonical Note.id and pass that complete identity through translate_qualified_name, matching EntityImageNote's use of Quark.getQualifiedName followed by SVG punctuation translation. Retain owner-plus-leaf reconstruction only for backward-compatible deserialized diagrams whose notes predate Note.id. Verify the independent custom-separator counterexample plus root, reopened-package, duplicate-local-alias, source/target, one-link/two-link, and rank-direction controls. Do not change layout constants, comparator behavior, or SVG strings after rendering.
perturbation_axes: relationship declared inside the owning package versus after the package is reopened
note as source versus note as target
